title: South Florida Halloween Plans This Weekend
igCaption:
South Florida has a few Halloween plans this weekend.
Check event pages for cover and timing.

Sources: Sun Sentinel, Secret Miami

#SouthFlorida #HalloweenWeekend #FortLauderdale #Broward

scenes.text: Need a Halloween plan for Saturday in South Florida? Start with the pop-ups, then choose the one that fits your group.
Sun Sentinel’s South Florida Halloween roundup includes a Carrie-themed speakeasy and a haunted kitchen. Both lean into the spooky side of the season.
scenes.caption: Sun Sentinel’s South Florida Halloween roundup includes a Carrie-themed speakeasy and a haunted kitchen.

scenes.text: In Brickell, DC Pie Co. gives kids 12 and under a free personal pizza with a purchase on October 31. Next door, Dom’s turns into a Trick or Tequila party for adults at 5 p.m.
scenes.caption: In Brickell, DC Pie Co. gives kids 12 and under a free personal pizza with a purchase on Oct. 31. Next door, Dom’s turns into a Trick or Tequila party for adults at 5 p.m.

scenes.text: Dom’s adds a costume contest, tequila specials, and a DJ. Costumes get you a free tequila shot with purchase, and the best-dressed guest gets a 150-dollar gift card. If you go, open NEAR and see who else showed up in costume.
scenes.caption: Dom’s adds a costume contest, tequila specials, and a DJ. Costumes get you a free tequila shot with purchase, and the best-dressed guest gets a $150 gift card. If you go, open NEAR and see who else showed up in costume.

scenes.text: Mounts Botanical Garden starts ILUMINA on November 18. The lantern festival runs through January 17, 2027, and tickets start at $10 for children and $28 for adults.
scenes.caption: Mounts Botanical Garden starts ILUMINA on Nov. 18. The lantern festival runs through Jan. 17, 2027, and tickets start at $10 for children and $28 for adults.

scenes.text: Which South Florida Halloween stop should we map next? It is the same feeling as spotting someone in costume all night and never learning their name, which is exactly where the NEAR app comes in.
